title: 2018 AMC 8 Problem 3
statement: Students Arn, Bob, Cyd, Dan, Eve, and Fon are arranged in that order in a circle. They start counting: Arn first, then Bob, and so forth. When the number contains a \(7\) as a digit (such as \(47\)) or is a multiple of \(7\) that person leaves the circle and the counting continues. Who is the last one present in the circle?

solutions.text:
The first five removal numbers are \(7,14,17,21,27.\) Tracking only those turns gives:

Arn says \(7\), Cyd says \(14\), Fon says \(17\), Bob says \(21\), and Eve says \(27\).

Dan is the only student remaining, so D is the correct answer.
hints: Simulate only the numbers that cause someone to leave.
Keep the counting order after each person leaves; the next number goes to the next person still in the circle.
